comments.author: @davidnicosia9055
comments.text: The AMOC is not going to collapse. Paleoclimatology shows that past AMOC disruptions were driven by massive freshwater pulses from colossal continental ice sheets during glacial retreats—conditions that simply do not exist during our current interglacial period. There is nowhere near enough land ice left in the Northern Hemisphere to trigger such a shutdown. Furthermore, sea ice melting does not freshen the North Atlantic, and pointing to vague, non-existent ice sources is pure hyperbole. Conflating stable interglacial fluctuations with an imminent tipping-point 'collapse' ignores the geological record. This is climate sensationalism and scare tactics, not rigorous science.
